name: r6-f-e1-libpipe
author: solx-loop
description: H32, lineage F. A library-lean pipeline for the C>=192, HW<=784 rows. K1 runs in clusters of 8 CTAs: a bulk-plane conv, LayerNorm finished in-CTA through a DSMEM exchange of per-token sum/sumsq, and role CTAs that convert W1/W2 to fp16 and fold b2' = W2.gb + b2 into hi/lo columns of W2. G1 is cuBLASLt fp16 with a BIAS epilogue and fp32 output. K3 is one launch: exact-erf GELU, GRN statistics through a self-resetting 64-bit per-image cell, in-place scale to fp16. G2 is cuBLASLt: NCHW swap-AB batc
